facts.text: Assumption University is a Catholic university founded by the Augustinians of the Assumption, located in Worcester, Massachusetts.

sources.title: Study Abroad - Assumption University
sources.quote: A Catholic university founded by the Augustinians of the Assumption, located in the heart of New England in Worcester, Massachusetts.

facts.text: Assumption University applies all home financial aid, including institutional scholarships, toward approved semester study abroad programs.

sources.title: Study Abroad - Assumption University
sources.quote: Assumption University will bill you for home tuition and the standard room and board fee, applying to that bill all financial aid that would have applied to a semester at home, whether federal, private, or Assumption scholarship funds.
